features: Implemented multiple character support with a shared stash, allowing seamless switching between account characters and preserving legacy heroes.
Revamped new player experience defaults, including automatic equipping of items and spells upon creation and improved hero roster functionality.
Enhanced the devlog portal by adding community request processing, status updates (including AI marking), and detailed explanations of the development process.
Added a full suite of immersive combat sounds and dynamic battle music, alongside major quality-of-life improvements for mobile touch controls and general UI alignment.

fix(ui): clones and invader name label displacement

commits.title: balance(combat): revise status and blocking rules
commits.description:
- scale Voodoo poison amplification from 1x at level 1 to 2x at level 99

- make Poison, Bleed, and Burn ticks bypass dodge and block

- remove Blocking's reactive cooldown and allow consecutive block rolls

- guarantee Penance restores at least 1% of maximum Mana per successful block

- cap buckler, Katar, and Reflective Surge block chance at 90%

- synchronize combat projections, tooltips, specs, and boundary tests
